question: How can I track my order?
answer: Once your order ships, you'll get a tracking link by email. You can also sign in and open My Orders to see live status at any time.

question: How do I cancel my order?
answer: Go to My Orders and select Cancel Order next to the item. Orders can only be cancelled before they enter the packing stage, usually within 1 hour of placing them.

question: Can I change my shipping address after placing an order?
answer: Yes, as long as the order hasn't shipped yet. Go to My Orders, choose Edit Address, and update the details. Once it ships, the address can't be changed.

question: Can I place an order without creating an account?
answer: Yes, guest checkout is available. You'll just need a valid email address so we can send your order confirmation and tracking updates.

question: How do I apply a coupon or promo code?
answer: Enter your code in the Promo Code box at checkout and select Apply. The discount will update your total before you confirm payment.

question: How can I check if an item is in stock?
answer: The product page shows real-time availability. If an item is out of stock, you can turn on Notify Me to get an email as soon as it's back.

question: How long does shipping take?
answer: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days, and express shipping takes 1-2 business days. Delivery times may vary slightly for remote locations.

question: Do you offer international shipping?
answer: Yes, we ship to over 40 countries. International delivery typically takes 7-14 business days, and any customs fees are the customer's responsibility.

question: What happens if I miss my delivery?
answer: The courier will usually attempt delivery again the next business day. You can also reschedule or choose a pickup point using the link in your tracking email.

question: Do you offer cash on delivery?
answer: Cash on delivery is available for domestic orders under a certain value. You'll see the option at checkout automatically if your order qualifies.

question: How much does shipping cost?
answer: Standard shipping is free on orders over $50; otherwise it's a flat $4.99. Express shipping is a flat $12.99 regardless of order size.

question: How do I return a product?
answer: Go to My Orders, select the item, and click Start a Return. Print the prepaid label, drop the package off at any courier point, and we'll take it from there.

question: What is your refund policy?
answer: Returns are accepted within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, as long as items are unused and in their original packaging. Refunds are issued to your original payment method.

question: How long does a refund take to process?
answer: Refunds are processed within 3-5 business days of us receiving your return, though it can take a few extra days for your bank to show the credit.

question: What should I do if I received a damaged product?
answer: Sorry about that! Please contact support within 48 hours with a photo of the damage, and we'll send a free replacement or a full refund, your choice.

question: Can I exchange a product for a different size?
answer: Yes, select Exchange instead of Return in My Orders and pick the new size. Exchanges ship out as soon as your original item is scanned by the courier.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards, PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and cash on delivery in eligible regions.

question: Is my payment information secure?
answer: Yes. All payments are processed through encrypted, PCI-compliant gateways, and we never store your full card details on our servers.

question: Why was my payment declined?
answer: This is usually due to a bank security check, incorrect card details, or insufficient funds. Try again or use a different payment method, or contact your bank if it persists.

question: Do you offer installment or pay-later options?
answer: Yes, we support installment payments through Klarna and Afterpay at checkout, subject to their approval.

question: How do I create an account?
answer: Click Sign Up in the top right corner, enter your email and a password, and confirm your address using the link we send you.

question: I forgot my password, what do I do?
answer: Click Forgot Password on the sign-in page and enter your email. We'll send a secure reset link that's valid for 30 minutes.

question: Is my personal information kept private?
answer: Yes, we only use your data to process orders and improve your experience, and we never sell it to third parties. See our Privacy Policy for full details.

question: How do I unsubscribe from marketing emails?
answer: Click Unsubscribe at the bottom of any marketing email, or turn off Email Offers under Account Settings > Notifications.

question: What are your customer support hours?
answer: Our support team is available Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 8 PM. Outside those hours, you can always leave a message and we'll reply the next morning.

question: How can I contact customer support?
answer: You can chat with me anytime, email support@example.com, or call +1-800-555-0199 during business hours.

question: Do you have a mobile app?
answer: Yes, our app is available for iOS and Android. Search for our store name on the App Store or Google Play to download it for free.

question: Do you offer gift wrapping?
answer: Yes, select Add Gift Wrap at checkout for a small fee. You can also include a free personalized gift note.

question: What is your warranty policy?
answer: Most products carry a 1-year manufacturer's warranty against defects. Check the product page for the exact warranty period on a specific item.

question: Do you offer student discounts?
answer: Yes, verified students get 10% off. Verify your student status through our partner UNiDAYS to receive your unique discount code.
